[[File:King_of_the_Dragonsakes.jpg|thumb|The King of the Dragonsnakes in his lair]]
The '''Lair of the King of the Dragonsnakes''' was located on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], beneath a [[Unidentified Jagged Place (Dagobah)|jagged place]] filled with dangerous wildlife. During his training by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] traveled to the place and confronted the [[King of the Dragonsnakes]] in his Lair. The lair contained a special treasure, the egg of an [[Accipiptero/Legends|Accipiptero]]. The King of the Dragonsnakes was eventually defeated, and the egg was taken by Luke Skywalker.
